notes: 同步完成重启时把 DSH 的默认工作区校正到 default-workspace，让重启后自动打开的新会话落在默认工作区里。客户端重启后会自己开一个新会话，落点由 ~\.dsh\storages\workspace.json 的 global.defaultWorkspaceId 决定；这个值 DSH 只在本机首次初始化时写过一次，同步几轮之后就停在某个「上次用的工作区」上（本机实测停在 G:\DeepSeekHarness\DSH破甲，而名为 default-workspace 的工作区在 C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace）。改动：post-exit.ps1 新增 Set-DefaultWorkspace，在客户端已完全退出、重新拉起之前（RestartClient 里、Start-Detached 之前）校正这个值——早写会被客户端退出时的回写盖掉；index.js 增加设置字段 defaultWorkspace（留空 = 自动找标题或路径为 default-workspace 的工作区；填工作区 ID 或绝对路径 = 指定；填 off = 不干预），保存路由与返回体一并带上该字段。安全措施：只在值真的不同时才写，写前原样备份 workspace.json.bak-<时间>，写完回读校验 defaultWorkspaceId 与工作区条数，校验不过就保留备份并记日志；设置里的路径匹配不到工作区时跳过不动。单元验证 6 个用例全过（自动 / off / 指定路径 / 指定 ID / 幂等重跑 / 无效路径），node --check 与四个 ps1 解析均通过。
notesEn: Correct DSH's default workspace to default-workspace when the client restarts after a sync, so the new session the client opens on startup lands in the default workspace. The client opens a fresh session after restart, and its landing spot is decided by global.defaultWorkspaceId in ~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json. DSH writes that value only during first-time initialization, so after a few syncs it stays on whatever workspace was used last (on this machine it was stuck on G:\DeepSeekHarness\DSH破甲, while the workspace actually named default-workspace lives at C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace). Change: post-exit.ps1 gains Set-DefaultWorkspace, which corrects the value after the client has fully exited and before it is relaunched (inside RestartClient, ahead of Start-Detached) - writing earlier would be overwritten by the client's exit-time write-back. index.js gains a defaultWorkspace setting (empty = auto-detect the workspace titled or pathed default-workspace; a workspace ID or absolute path = use that one; off = do nothing), carried through the save route and the settings response. Safety: the file is only touched when the value actually differs, the original is backed up as workspace.json.bak-<timestamp> first, and the result is read back and checked (defaultWorkspaceId plus workspace count); a failed check keeps the backup and logs it. A path in the setting that matches no workspace is skipped, never guessed. Six unit cases pass (auto / off / explicit path / explicit ID / idempotent rerun / invalid path), and node --check plus parsing of all four ps1 files are clean.
